authority_boundaries.021G: Owns recovery-side effect uncertainty ledger and reconcile-before-replay disposition.
authority_boundaries.021J_021K: Own transport/effect execution and external transaction semantics; G-WP-007 consumes stable effect identities, receipts, and authorized query observations only.
authority_boundaries.provider_calls: No provider execution occurs inside pure replay or the local ledger transaction. Observations are supplied from an authorized external query/receipt path.

unknown_policy: PENDING, UNKNOWN, and DIVERGED block unsafe replay until evidence resolves the effect.
